Hi Sam, Lisa - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + next steps from our call: 

1) What we heard from you
- You need a vendor that can sign a BAA and demonstrate HIPAA controls for a pilot (PHI scope limited to tokenized IDs).
- You also want SOC 2 evidence for our hosted + dedicated options; GDPR alignment for EU data residents.
- Internal security review target: complete by Fri, 05 Nov 2026.

2) Redwood summary (high level)
- We maintain a current SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted inference service (attached).
- Dedicated and Private deployments are supported; we have encryption-at-rest + in-transit by default, and KMS/HSM integrations available.
- We are starting a SOC scope expansion to include our Private control plane in H1 2027 and have an ISO 27001 roadmap (details below).

3) Requested items / next steps
- I've attached our vendor questionnaire template (vendor_questionnaire_fairbank_v1.xlsx) - if you can drop your questionnaire back to us we'll pre-fill the sections we have answers for.
- Rishi will follow up with specific control mappings (SOC 2, HIPAA) and a technical deep-dive next week.
- Please confirm if the BAA needs to be signed before pilot kick-off or can be executed post-POC contract.

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_fairbank_v1.xlsx

Thanks - I'll coordinate timelines on our side and propose a 45-minute technical deep-dive for next week.

Hi Sam, Lisa - following up with technical notes from our side and a few clarifications.

Short answers up-front:
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for our hosted inference (period: Jan-Dec 2025). I've attached the redacted PDF: SOC2-Report-2025.pdf. We are planning a scope expansion to include Private deployments (expected attestation window H1 2027).
- HIPAA / BAA: We can execute a BAA; standard template available. For the pilot, if you need it signed pre-POC we can prioritize.
- GDPR: Data residency controls + DSAR processes are documented; we support region-specific routing and can provide the processing addendum.

Control mapping notes for the questionnaire: 
- Authentication / Access: RBAC + SCIM provisioning supported (SAML/OIDC).
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest with customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations; TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Logging / Audit: Per-route token-level logging with retention configurable; audit logs can be exported to your SIEM.
- Incident Response: 24/7 security on-call, playbooks, and SLA escalation; we provide incident reports within 72 hours of triage.

Planned roadmap (high level):
- Q4 2026: Finalize SOC scope expansion plan and begin additional control implementation for Private deployments.
- H1 2027: SOC 2 Type II reassessment to cover Private control plane.
- 2027: ISO 27001 gap assessment planned for mid-2027; target certification by end of 2027 depending on audit windows.
- FedRAMP: exploratory conversations for FedRAMP Ready - multiyear effort; if needed we'll surface dedicated engagement.

If you can attach your vendor questionnaire (or point us to the doc), I'll pre-fill the technical answers and return within 3 business days.

Attachment: SOC2-Report-2025.pdf

On a logistics note: if you need encrypted transfer of the SOC report or additional artifacts, tell us which method you prefer (Secure Share link / SFTP / encrypted zip).

Thanks,
Rishi
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
